notes: Each button straddles the centre gap: one side (columns 6/11/16/21/26) carries the signal pin and a 10k pulldown resistor to the GND rail; the other side (columns 8/13/18/23/28) is fed from the 5V rail by a red wire.
Buttons map to pins 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 from left to right, as in the schematic.
Rail hole numbers (tp.n, bn.n) are approximate, set to the nearest column number. The 5V wire is on the top plus rail; the GND wire and resistor ends are on the bottom minus rail.
Row letters follow the catalogue (top half 't' rows a-e, bottom half 'b' rows f-j). Specific rows are assumed from the image, which shows legs and wires only near the gap or rail.
The micro-USB cable has no ports in the catalogue, so it is joined to the board without ports. It powers the board and links it to the computer.
The pushbutton's side 1 is on columns 6/11/16/21/26 and side 2 on columns 8/13/18/23/28; the image does not show which physical legs are which.
The first GND pin next to 5V is taken as GND.1.
